vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.uitleg.1: A pink watchtower with the teleport stone and the squad vault.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.uitleg.2: A walled court with a gatehouse and the Trophy Hall: every boss you beat gets a spot there.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.uitleg.3: A stronghold with two corner towers, a smithy and a kitchen (Profession workshops).
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.uitleg.4: A fortress with four corner towers, a sewing studio, a brewery and a garden.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.uitleg.5: The Snuggle Castle: a great keep with a party hall full of chandeliers, spires and all the trimmings.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.niets: You carry nothing the castle still needs.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.gedoneerd: %s brought %s building materials to the castle.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.gedoneerd_ok: You gave %s building materials to the castle. Thank you!
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.nog_niet: The castle can't grow yet: see /bond kasteel for what's missing.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.gebouwd: The castle has grown into a %s (level %s)!
vadsrijk.gilden.perk.basis: Squad chat, a name badge, a banner and the Watchtower with 1 vault tab
vadsrijk.gilden.perk.rust: Squad Rest: time offline fills a rest pool; while it lasts you get %s%% more combat xp
vadsrijk.gilden.perk.rust2: Squad Rest II: the rest pool fills twice as fast and holds twice as much
vadsrijk.gilden.perk.reis: %s%% discount on the luxury travel-map flight
vadsrijk.gilden.perk.tp: Teleport to the castle: every %s minutes
vadsrijk.gilden.perk.goud: A golden frame around your squad name on the ranking
vadsrijk.gilden.taak.klaar: Weekly task done: %s! +%s squad xp and %s in the treasury.
vadsrijk.gilden.taak.alle: All three weekly tasks done! Another +%s squad xp.
vadsrijk.gilden.auto_lid: %s has contributed enough and is now a member.
vadsrijk.gilden.opgericht: You founded the Snuggle Squad %s! Your plot with a watchtower is ready in the Squad Valley.
vadsrijk.gilden.toegetreden: Welcome to %s! Type /bond for your squad panel.
vadsrijk.gilden.aangemeld: Your application to %s has been sent. An officer will look at it.
vadsrijk.gilden.verwijderd: %s was removed from the squad by %s.
vadsrijk.gilden.nieuwe_leider: %s is the new leader of the squad!
vadsrijk.gilden.opgeheven: The Snuggle Squad %s has been disbanded.
vadsrijk.gilden.opgeheven_ok: %s has been disbanded. The treasury and building depot went to you.
vadsrijk.gilden.kas_ok: You put %s in the squad treasury.
vadsrijk.gilden.trofee: New trophy in the Trophy Hall: %s!
vadsrijk.gilden.rust.vol: Squad Rest: your rest pool now holds %s xp (+50%% combat xp until it's empty).
vadsrijk.gilden.chat.aan: Squad chat ON: what you type goes to your squad. Start with ! to talk to everyone just once.
vadsrijk.gilden.chat.uit: Squad chat OFF: you're talking to everyone again.
vadsrijk.gilden.verlaat.zeker: Are you sure you want to leave the squad?
vadsrijk.gilden.ophef.zeker: Are you sure you want to DISBAND the squad? The castle will disappear.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.geen_bond: You're not in a Snuggle Squad (with this character).
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.klerk: You can only found a squad at the Squad Clerk in the Highchonk chancellery.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.te_vroeg: You can found a squad once zone 4 is done, or from level %s.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.naam: A squad name is 3 to 20 characters: letters, digits, spaces and dashes.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.tag: A tag is 2 to 4 letters or digits, like PINK.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.bezet: That name or tag already belongs to another squad.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.werft_niet: That squad isn't recruiting right now.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.min_level: That squad takes members from level %s.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.leider_eerst: First hand the leadership to someone else (/bond leden, ♛).
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.rang_hoog: You can only do that to someone of a lower rank.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.bank_vol: Empty the squad vault first: nothing may ever get lost.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.geen_kasteel: You don't have a castle yet.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.rijk: That only works in the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.stad: You can teleport to your castle from any town (Camp Snuggle, Shroomsbury, Sugarbowl, Honeybough, Lanternhaven, Highchonk).
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.steen: Touch the teleport stone in your castle first.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.geen_terug: There's no place to go back to.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.hub_dicht: You haven't been there yet (follow the story).
vadsrijk.gilden.tp.wacht: The teleport stone needs to rest for %s.
vadsrijk.gilden.tp.terug: Back to where you came from.
vadsrijk.gilden.vallei.welkom: Welcome to the Squad Valley! Every Snuggle Squad has a plot here with its own castle.
vadsrijk.gilden.vallei.gevangen: A little cloud caught you and brought you back to the square.
vadsrijk.gilden.bank.info_ja: %s: you can put things in and take things out here
vadsrijk.gilden.bank.info_nee: %s: you can only put things in here
vadsrijk.gilden.paneel.geen: You're not in a Snuggle Squad yet (with this character). Apply at the Squad Board in any town, or get invited.
vadsrijk.gilden.paneel.taken_uitleg: Each finished task: +%s squad xp and %s in the treasury; all three: another +%s squad xp.
vadsrijk.gilden.paneel.perks_uitleg: Squad xp comes all by itself: from creatures, bosses, quests, levels and professions of every member (max 600 per member per day).
vadsrijk.gilden.paneel.bord: Squad Board: squads looking for members
vadsrijk.gilden.uitleg.1: A Snuggle Squad is a club of knights who make the Chonkdom happier together. You can join anywhere: at the Squad Board in any town, or with an invitation.
vadsrijk.gilden.uitleg.2: You can only found a squad here in Highchonk, at the Squad Clerk. It costs %s and you need zone 4 done, or level %s.
vadsrijk.gilden.uitleg.3: Everything members do (creatures, bosses, quests, professions) gives squad xp. Squad levels give handy perks, not big stats.
vadsrijk.gilden.uitleg.4: Every squad gets a plot in the Squad Valley with a castle you build up together: from watchtower to Snuggle Castle.
vadsrijk.gilden.bord.leeg: No squad is recruiting right now.
vadsrijk.gilden.bord.zelf: Want to found your own squad? Visit the Squad Clerk in Highchonk.
vadsrijk.gilden.banier.hover: (hover over the name to see the banner)
vadsrijk.gilden.knop.typ: Click: the command appears in your chat, fill it in and press Enter
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.hallo: Good day! I'm Stampy, the Squad Clerk. I'm the one who registers new Snuggle Squads. Stamp it, done!
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.al: You're already in a squad! One squad per knight, that's the rule.
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.te_vroeg: Your own squad? Come back once you've finished zone 4, or when you're level %s. You can already join a squad, though!
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.oprichten: Wonderful! Registering a squad costs %s. Pick a name and a short tag of 2 to 4 characters, and I'll stamp it in.
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.typ: Found a squad: click here and fill in your tag and name ->
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.poortwachter.hallo: Beyond this gate lies the Squad Valley: every Snuggle Squad has its own castle there. Want to go?
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.pleinwachter.hallo: Welcome to the Squad Valley! I'll take you back to Highchonk, or to your squad's castle.
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.bord.hallo: Take a look at the Squad Board! All the Snuggle Squads looking for new members are pinned up here.
vadsrijk.gilden.optie.oprichten: I want to found a squad
vadsrijk.gilden.tip.vallei: The Squad Valley: the gate back to Highchonk is on the square. Find your castle via /bond, [To our castle].
vadsrijk.gilden.tip.bank: The squad vault belongs to the whole squad. Recruits can only put things in; members can also take from tab 1; officers from every tab.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_klerk.1: A little stamp here, a little stamp there!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_klerk.2: A squad without a tag is like a guh without ears.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_klerk.3: I've registered more squads than there are clouds in the sky. Almost.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_poortwachter.1: The gate is always open to friends.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_poortwachter.2: Behind it stand the finest castles of the whole Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_pleinwachter.1: Every plot a castle, every castle a squad.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_pleinwachter.2: Don't lean over the edge, now!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_pleinwachter.3: The finest castle? You build it together.

vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_bord_vallei.3: Find a squad here, and friends too.
